entity_raw.definition_raw: Defense SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): ProtectionAssociated Deities: Abadar, Acavna, Alseta, Amaznen, Andoletta, Anubis, Arazni, Aroggus, Arqueros, Ashukharma, Bastet, Bes, Bohga, Chadali, Cihua Couatl, Dalenydra, Dretha, Grundinnar, Haborym, Jaidz, Korada, Lorris, Milani, Nephthys, Nethys, Olheon, Ondisso, Rowdrosh, Selket, Shelyn, Shelyn (pre-Earthfall), Soralyon, Torag, Trudd, Wadjet, Winlas, Wylgart, Yamatsumi, YigReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the resistant touch power of the Protection domain. Deflection Aura (Su): Once each day, you can emit a 20-foot aura for a number of rounds equal to your cleric level. Allies within the aura gain a +2 deflection bonus to AC and combat maneuver defense.Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—shield, 2nd—barkskin, 7th—deflection.
